# My Agent

Describe what your agent does here.

This agent helps automate testing for your website. It can:

- Generate test cases based on user flows and features
- Create automated test scripts using tools like Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium
- Simulate real user interactions such as clicking, typing, navigation, and form submission
- Detect common UI/UX issues and functional bugs
- Suggest improvements for test coverage and performance
- Assist in debugging failing tests and improving reliability

Use this agent to speed up QA processes, improve test coverage, and ensure your web application behaves correctly across different scenarios.
